$comment: Upload variants. Each is a prefab variant of the root avatar prefab (or of the variant it `extends`) with feature prefabs added as children; `features` lists the ones the generator makes sure are present. Slugs are the names the avatar is uploaded under. `about` is for whoever reads this file and is not sent anywhere. Features whose package is not installed are skipped with a warning. `worstRank` is the worst VRChat performance rank the variant may build to on PC and `worstRankMobile` on Android and iOS; the checks fail if it ranks lower. `model` is the fidelity level a variant is built from: left out, the full model on PC and the lite one on Android and iOS; "lite", the lite one everywhere. `platforms` (pc, android, ios; all three when left out) says what the variant is built for. Features that cannot work on mobile say so themselves and are left out of those builds.
description: Cassidy's avatar. AGPLv3. github.com/CassidyPrather/cass-avatar Body: SiroinoSotai by Siroino. Face: Mizunashi Hiyori by HENGE.

variants.about: Everyday build: default outfit, weighty locomotion, face tracking.
The everyday build from the low-polygon model, for PC as well: the same avatar and features at well under half the triangles.
Adventure build: adds flight, a carry seat, a catch-up portal and the hand tools.

The adventure build with one real light source: the flashlight, a spotlight, which can be left standing in the world. It replaces both of cass-adv's glowing stand-ins. Any light on an avatar ranks it Poor and a second Very Poor, hence one light and a variant of its own.

The adventure build with one real light source: the lantern, a point light, which can be left standing in the world. It replaces both of cass-adv's glowing stand-ins. Any light on an avatar ranks it Poor and a second Very Poor, hence one light and a variant of its own.
